message: What are we supposed to do with all of our Winston Select proofs as the Winston Select Catalog catalogs have all expired and when we are stuck with a whole box of Winston Select proofs and every carton we get 20 more proofs? I think that it is only fair that you put out another Winston Select catalog. I took a beating on Camel eNotes the last time I got stuck with about 300 of them and I don’t feel like getting stuck with 300 proofs or purchasing Winston Select proofs if they still sell. If they then they should have a catalog to use them on. I don’t think the Maine attorney general’s office div consumer fraud if they are still being sold. There should be a way to use them.
